```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(omnideconv)
library(viper)
library(decoupleR)
set.seed(123)
seurat_anndata = LoadH5Seurat("~/all_samples.h5seurat",  assays = "RNA")
```

UMAP clustering
```{r}
Idents(seurat_anndata) = seurat_anndata@meta.data$annotated_ct
DimPlot(seurat_anndata, reduction="umap", label = T)
```

Metacells
```{r}
library(hdWGCNA)

data <- SetupForWGCNA(
  seurat_anndata,
  gene_select = "fraction", # the gene selection approach
  fraction = 0.05, # fraction of cells that a gene needs to be expressed in order to be included
  wgcna_name = "MetaCells" # the name of the hdWGCNA experiment
)

rm(seurat_anndata)
gc()

# construct metacells  in each group
seurat_obj <- MetacellsByGroups(
  seurat_obj = data,
  min_cells = 100,
  group.by = c("annotated_ct", "sample"), # specify the columns in seurat_obj@meta.data to group by
  reduction = 'pca', # select the dimensionality reduction to perform KNN on
  k = 25, # nearest-neighbors parameter
  max_shared = 15, # maximum number of shared cells between two metacells
  ident.group = 'annotated_ct' 
)

rm(data)
gc()

metacell_obj <- GetMetacellObject(seurat_obj)

rm(seurat_obj)
gc()
```

Subset each cluster and compute TF activity
```{r}
source("compute.TFs.activity.R")
cell_clusters = list()
iter = 1
for (i in unique(metacell_obj@meta.data$annotated_ct)) {
  cluster = subset(metacell_obj, idents = i, invert = FALSE)
  cell_clusters[[iter]] = compute.TFs.activity(as.matrix(cluster@assays$RNA@data))
  names(cell_clusters)[iter] = i
  iter = iter + 1
}

rm(metacell_obj, cluster)
gc()
```

Recreate sc_counts from TFs
```{r}
tfs_scores = do.call(rbind, cell_clusters)
cell_annotations = c()
for (i in 1:length(cell_clusters)) {
  cell = c(rep(names(cell_clusters)[i], nrow(cell_clusters[[i]])))
  cell_annotations = c(cell_annotations, cell)
}
```

Re-clustering
```{r}
########## TFs
data[["TF"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = t(tfs))
DefaultAssay(data) = "TF"
data@assays$TF@scale.data = t(tfs)

#Re-clustering
data = ScaleData(data)
data <- RunPCA(data, features = colnames(tfs))
ElbowPlot(data)
data = FindNeighbors(data, dims = 1:10, graph.name = c("TF_nn","TF_SNN"))
data = FindClusters(data, algorithm= 1, resolution = 1, graph.name = "TF_SNN")
data <- RunUMAP(data, dims = 1:10)
DimPlot(data, reduction="umap", label = T, pt.size = 1.5)
Idents(data) = data@meta.data$cell.annot
DimPlot(data, reduction="umap", label = T, pt.size = 1.5)
```

PSEUDOBULK
```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(glmGamPoi)
sce = as.SingleCellExperiment(seurat_anndata)
##Aggregating counts
aggr_counts <- glmGamPoi::pseudobulk(sce, group_by = vars(sample), aggregation_functions = list(counts = "rowMeans2", .default = "rowMeans2")) 
pseudo_counts = data.frame(aggr_counts@assays@data$counts) 
pseudo_counts = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(pseudo_counts) %>%
  data.frame()

source("../CellTFusion_paper/user_projects/src/cell_deconvolution.R")
deconv = compute.deconvolution(pseudo_counts, normalized = F, credentials.mail = "marcelo.hurtado@inserm.fr", 
                               credentials.token = "734212f6ad77fc4eea2bdb502792f294", 
                               doParallel = T, workers = 3, file_name = "Pseudobulk")
```

GROUNDTRUTH

Cell proportions 
```{r}
table(Idents(data)) # how many cells in each cluster
table(data$orig.ident) # how many cells per patient
table(Idents(data), data$orig.ident) # how many cells per patient in each cluster
DataClustTable = table(Idents(data), data$orig.ident) #Create data frame with number of cells per patient in each cluster
DataClustPercPat = data.frame(prop.table(table(Idents(data), data$orig.ident), margin = 2)) #Create data frame with proportion of cells per patient in each cluster
```

Groundtruth vs scRNASeq 
```{r}
source('pseudobulk_function.R')
corr_matrix = benchmarking_deconvolution(deconv, cells_groundtruth, file_name = "Benchmark_plot_pseudobulk_Vanderbilt_pearson", corr_type = "pearson")
```
